name: AI Lead Qualification Agent - Portfolio Demo

options.systemMessage: You are a B2B lead qualification analyst. Be conservative. A vague inquiry should not receive a high score. Output only the requested structured result.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "fit_score": 16,
  "problem_clarity": "high",
  "urgency": "medium",
  "intent_strength": "high",
  "summary": "Clear automation requirement with a near-term implementation timeline."
}

options.systemMessage: You write concise, natural B2B follow-up drafts. Avoid hype, fake personalization, and unsupported claims.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name, email: $json.email, company: $json.company, job_title: $json.job_title, company_size: $json.company_size || null, budget_range: $json.budget_range || null, timeline: $json.timeline || null, source: $json.source || null, message: $json.message, deterministic_score: $json.deterministic_score, ai_fit_score: $json.ai_fit_score, lead_score: $json.lead_score, tier: $json.tier, ai_summary: $json.ai_assessment?.summary || null, recommended_action: $json.recommended_action, approval_status: $json.approval_status }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { email: $json.email, lead_score: $json.lead_score, tier: $json.tier, deterministic_score: $json.deterministic_score, ai_fit_score: $json.ai_fit_score, reasoning: $json.ai_assessment?.summary || '', recommended_action: $json.recommended_action, approval_status: $json.approval_status, followup_draft: $json.followup_draft || null } }}
